name: codex-alert
description: Mac screen pulses and phone notifications when a local Codex task finishes.

interface.shortDescription: Know when your long Codex task is done.
interface.longDescription: Set up and manage a local macOS companion that pulses the screen edges and sends optional ntfy phone notifications after Codex tasks longer than two minutes. The background service requires running the included installer.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Codex Alert on my Mac.
Check whether Codex Alert is running.
Help me turn off phone notifications.
